stories.headline: Florida and DEA charge two Ocala suspects over a counterfeit fentanyl pill operation with about 6,000 pills and a press
stories.body: Florida's attorney general and the DEA announced trafficking charges against two Ocala residents after a joint probe that began with Tampa police and traced a pressed-pill supplier from Marion County into Hillsborough County. A search at a residence, executed around 28-29 October, turned up roughly 6,000 pills and a pill press. Both defendants are held without bond and more charges may follow lab testing.

stories.headline: French Navy stops a semi-submersible in the Atlantic for the first time, recovering 146 kg of cocaine
stories.body: On 12 November a French frigate's helicopter intercepted a stateless semi-submersible with four people aboard; three jumped overboard and one triggered a scuttling mechanism, but all were rescued and detained. About 146 kg of cocaine was recovered, and reports say several more tonnes sank with the boat. A US patrol aircraft, MAOC-N and JIATF South supported the operation, and France's OFAST Caraibes took over the case.
